name: Toronto-Dominion Bank (The) Preferred Shares (TD.PF.I)
summary: The Toronto-Dominion Bank and its affiliates provide financial services in Canada, the United States and other international markets through Canadian Retail, U.S. Retail and Wholesale Banking divisions. Its services include personal banking with chequing, savings and investment accounts, and business offerings such as funding, advice on investments, global trade support, treasury management and day-to-day banking.
